from __future__ import annotations
import importlib.util
import json
import shutil
import sys
from pathlib import Path

ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
if str(ROOT) not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0,str(ROOT))
from control.model_execution.direct_sol_chat import validate_request

rp=ROOT/"control/jobs/full_a2z_governed_v4.py"
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("a2z_runner_guard",rp)
mod=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(mod)

bundle=ROOT/"control/dev_checks/direct_sol_guard_bundle"
if bundle.exists():
    shutil.rmtree(bundle)
bundle.mkdir(parents=True)

try:
    mod.request(bundle, {}, "SOL_BUILD", "SHOULD-NOT-RUN", "legacy")
except ValueError as exc:
    assert str(exc)=="DIRECT_SOL_REQUIRED"
else:
    raise AssertionError("LEGACY_SOL_REQUEST_NOT_BLOCKED")

mod.direct_sol_request(
    bundle, {}, "SOL_BUILD", "DIRECT-SOL-PREFLIGHT", "safe prompt", "b"*64
)
obj=json.loads((bundle/"direct_requests/DIRECT-SOL-PREFLIGHT.json").read_text())
validate_request(obj)
assert obj["target_model"]=="gpt-5.6-sol"
assert obj["execution_layer"]=="DIRECT_SOL_CHAT"
assert obj["target_experience"]=="CHAT"
print("LEGACY_SOL_BLOCK=PASS")
print("DIRECT_SOL_REQUEST=PASS")
